name: fp-agency
description: Site institucional e portal FP Agency construidos com Astro.

scripts.dev: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; node -e "console.info('[fp-agency:ssr] INTERNAL_SECRET=' + (process.env.INTERNAL_SECRET ? 'present' : 'missing'))"; astro dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.dev:astro: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; node -e "console.info('[fp-agency:ssr] INTERNAL_SECRET=' + (process.env.INTERNAL_SECRET ? 'present' : 'missing'))"; astro dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.sync:secret: bash -lc 'set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; test -n "$INTERNAL_SECRET" || { echo "INTERNAL_SECRET ausente para o deploy Cloudflare." >&2; exit 1; }; printf "%s" "$INTERNAL_SECRET" | npx wrangler secret put INTERNAL_SECRET'
scripts.deploy: npm run sync:secret && npm run build:cf && wrangler deploy
scripts.preview: set -a; [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; set +a; node -e "console.info('[fp-agency:ssr] INTERNAL_SECRET=' + (process.env.INTERNAL_SECRET ? 'present' : 'missing'))"; astro preview
